card.line: Bahurim was a city of Benjamin east of Jerusalem on the road to the Jordan, where David met curses while fleeing and where two messengers hid in a well.

moments.title: Paltiel turns back
moments.text: Michal's husband Paltiel followed her, weeping all the way to Bahurim. Abner told him to go back, and he returned home.

moments.title: Shimei curses David
moments.text: As David came to Bahurim, Shimei of Saul's family yelled curses and threw stones at him. David would not let Abishai harm him, saying the LORD had told Shimei to curse.

moments.title: Hidden in a well
moments.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz climbed into a well at a man's house in Bahurim. His wife covered it with a cloth and grain, so Absalom's servants did not find them, and then the two warned David.

moments.title: Shimei asks forgiveness
moments.text: Shimei of Bahurim hurried down to meet David at the Jordan and begged him not to hold his sin against him. David spared him and said no one would be put to death that day.

moments.title: David's last words on Shimei
moments.text: Before he died, David told Solomon to keep an eye on Shimei of Bahurim. He reminded Solomon of the curses and of his own oath to Shimei by the LORD.
